name: Cup Strike
summary:
Cup Strike is an engaging physics-based shooting game built for immersive play. Aim at towers of stacked cups placed at different distances and test your precision and focus.

The game now features a new settings panel that gives you full control over your experience in a simple and intuitive way. You can easily customize how the game looks and feels without interrupting gameplay.
